answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with a device-bound reputation bond. First, each agent registers one hardware key and locks a $200 bond. Second, a shared atlas of verified agents records every job, so a new identity starts in an umber quarantine tier with tiny limits. Third, trust grows only through completed work, and any delta between claimed and delivered output triggers an audit. Forging 10,000 fake identities burns $2,000,000 in bonds plus 45 days of setup, while honest agents keep full access. Like a passport that cannot be photocopied, one key means one citizen. - Jowy
